about: Spatial air traffic control for on-screen HUDs. Every HUD gets a reserved slot that never moves at runtime, so one HUD resizing can't push its neighbours. The slot is the default spot: HUDs Matt drags/resizes remember his frame in hud_positions.json (hud-kit HUDWindow), which then wins. dx/dy = distance from the slot's corner to the screen edges (visible frame, menu bar excluded); w/h = the most space the HUD may ever use. screen: builtin (laptop, else Sidecar/iPad, else primary), primary (menu-bar screen), cursor (screen under the mouse). Check for overlaps: hs -c 'return require("modules.hud_layout").report()' or lua tests/hud_layout_test.lua. Read by Hammerspoon (modules/hud_layout.lua) and TrackpadMixer (~/projects/hud-kit/Sources/Slots.swift).
